name: TMGMT Crowdin
description: Crowdin plugin to localize Drupal websites.
project_description:
Overview 
 Crowdin Translation Plugin for the Translation Management Tool (TMGMT) module allows you to make your Drupal website multilingual. Synchronize content for translation directly to your localization project in Crowdin and send translations back to your site.

 Features 
 
 Sync content for translation with your localization project and transfer completed translations back to your Drupal website. 
 Automate content translation using Machine Translation engines. 
 Get translations from Crowdin Marketplace professional translation agencies or bring your translation team. 
 Use comments, labels, and Glossary terms to provide translators with context, get relevant translations, and save time discussing how each text is used. 
 Enable Quality Assurance checks to efficiently handle different language-specific aspects in translations and make sure they are formatted the same way as the source strings and fit the UI. 
 Leverage Translation memory to reuse content strings translated before for the same or similar content you add. 
 Use Crowdin not only to translate your Drupal website but any other content you have. Localize your emails, assets, ads, software and apps. This way, you’ll speak the same language as your customer at all touchpoints. Crowdin has 280+ integrations, so you can automate content sync between Crowdin and the tools you use. 
 
 Crowdin Translation Plugin supports Drupal 8, 9 and 10. 

 Requirements 
 Crowdin Translation Plugin requires the Translation Management Tool (TMGMT) module and an account on Crowdin with a localization project.

 About Crowdin 
 Crowdin is a localization management platform that helps companies, teams, and individuals stay agile when translating mobile, desktop & web apps, websites, games, help documentation, and other content. Crowdin has 2M+ registered user accounts, 100K+ localization projects, and customers from 160+ countries. Among customers, you can find companies like GitLab, GitHub, Calendly, Discord, and Kickstarter.
